eval_feedback: Showcase greenfield-cap run: 16/16, rubric 10/10. The CAPPED terminal tag is used correctly — a genuinely material axis (settlement period/scope) went unasked at cap=2 and sits in Still Open with a resolution path rather than being invented as an assumption, exactly the honest-triage behavior eval-4 tests. Fabrication hunt is clean: every brief-only specific (mentor count, July, CSV fallback, 1원-unit, terminal/CLI exec preference) is absent, and the 3.3% withholding-tax unknown-unknown was interviewer-elicited, not assumed. One watch-item for the eval set, not this run: R2's slot allocation left the period axis for the cap while spending one on output-location — the two are comparably material, so a brief that runs out of ambiguity would better exercise the COMPLETE path; every with_skill run this iteration still ends CAPPED/owner-blocked, leaving the exit-control-question clause untested by eval-4.
